title: Dua to Maang Sakina ka waasta deke
body:
Hai baab e hawaej maula..(2)
saqqa e sakina maula..
hai baab e hawaej maula
dua to maang sakina ka wasta deke..(2)
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Alam pe jaake sakina ka waasta dena
farera thaam ke ghum apne sab suna dena
jalana naam e sakina ka ek diya jaake
<<MINI>>
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Alam pe jao to bachho ko saath le jao
waha'n sakina ka pursa do phir dua mango
tumhare haq mein sakina jo khud dua karde
<<MINI>>
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Rida e zainab e muztar ka waasta dena
ghareeb e zehra ka sharbat pe fatiha dena
duaein maangna haatho'n mein baliya'n rakh ke
<<MINI>>
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
hai baab e hawaej maula..(2)
saqqa e sakina maula..
hai baab e hawaej maula
dua to maang sakina ka wasta deke
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ataa kare jo khuda mujhko ek ghar apna
rakhunga ghar mein sakina ke naam ka hujra
alam ko thaam ke mannat ye maan le roke
<<MINI>>
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jo tune maangli aulaad aur ye socha
use sakina ka saqqa main khud banaunga
niyat ye karli jo tune duao'n se pehle
<<MINI>>
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Baland bus ye aqeeda hai mazhar o farhan
husainiyo ki to raahat ka hai yehi saamaan
jo panjetan ke bhikaari bano salike se
<<MINI>>
ye kaise hoga ke abbas aur ataa na kare

hai baab e hawaej maula
